method: Two fresh read-only pressure agents per condition; identical scenarios; static pytest contract.

observed_efficiency_gaps: P1 protocol introduced an additional implementation worktree before local-main integration.
Neither protocol imposed an explicit graph-query cap or compact authority ledger.

improvements: P1 reused the current feature branch and limited a clean worktree to safe local-main integration.
Both protocols used a one-line authority ledger, CRG minimal context, directed-query caps, source validation, and invalidated-gate-only reruns.

limitations: The agent harness did not expose comparable model token counters, so this evaluation proves protocol compression rather than a numeric token percentage.
No production code or remote provider was exercised by the pressure scenarios.
